sources.quote: Claude 3.5 Sonnet Our most intelligent model to date 200K context window Input $3 / MTok Prompt caching $3.75 / MTok - Cache write $0.30 / MTok - Cache read Output $15 / MTok
sources.supports: Anthropic's own prompt caching page lists Claude 3.5 Sonnet's $3 input, $15 output, $0.30 cache read, and $3.75 cache write prices. The page identifies a December 17, 2024 update, before the models.dev record.

sources.quote: Claude Sonnet 3.5 (deprecated)  | $3 / MTok  | $3.75 / MTok  | $6 / MTok  | $0.30 / MTok  | $15 / MTok
sources.supports: Anthropic's pricing documentation also gives the 3.5 Sonnet cache write as $3.75/MTok, consistent with the announcement's cache-read/cache-write distinction.

notes: The earlier $0.30 cache_write appears to have copied the official cache_read amount; Anthropic's own announcement had listed cache_write at $3.75/MTok before June 2025. The Wayback CDX request returned a temporary 503/Offline page, so archived snapshots could not be used to bracket any price change; no provider change date is supported.
